question: Should OpenClaw publish a public OpenAPI/Swagger contract for Gateway programmatic access, and if so should it be a static artifact, an authenticated runtime endpoint, or a documented TypeBox/JSON Schema client-generation path?
rationale: The requested schema would define public endpoint coverage, auth visibility, plugin-route exposure, versioning, and upgrade compatibility, which automation should not decide from source structure alone.

options.title: Design Public Schema Contract First
options.body: Keep this issue open until maintainers choose the schema format, exposure path, API coverage, and security/versioning boundary.

options.title: Narrow To Static Artifact
options.body: Publish a versioned schema artifact for client generation without adding a runtime endpoint until auth and plugin-route exposure are settled.

options.title: Use Existing Protocol Docs
options.body: Close later only if maintainers decide the Gateway TypeBox/JSON Schema and protocol docs are the supported client-generation surface.

recommendation.title: Design Public Schema Contract First
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open until maintainers choose the schema format, exposure path, API coverage, and security/versioning boundary.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest recent ownership signal across the current Gateway protocol/docs files that define the public integration surface.
